methodology.source: Six existing library.db files under ~/.local/share/bokheim/libraries, opened mode=ro by Python SQLite backup into consistent SSD snapshots under ~/.cache/bokheim/local-query-benchmark-20261118. Live databases were not migrated or edited.
methodology.profile: Workspace release: opt-level 3, fat LTO, one codegen unit.
methodology.workload: Production synchronous Database::browse_page (Books and root Folder), notebook, text_search and bounded text_search_matches. Generic prefixes, ordinary words and no-match query. Five fresh connections per case, immediately repeated on the same connection for cached timings.
methodology.timing: Database::open excluded. Fresh includes selection preparation, filtering, ordering and first-page hydration with new SQLite/result caches. Cached repeats hit prepared result cache. OS filesystem cache is warm; these are not cold-disk measurements.
methodology.page_sizes: Browse default 48 direct books / 24 sections. Notebook and full text 8 books, 8 match slots per full-text book, as initial UI loads.
methodology.exclusions: UI timers/rendering, async scheduling/IPC, catalog queries, and opening book files to resolve actual excerpt text. Notebook has just seven annotations, so it does not represent annotation-heavy libraries.
methodology.read_only_scope: Only snapshot files are opened by the production API; initialization/migration is not called.
